scientific limitations/integrity: The result is an exact finite classification for prescribed-difference perfect matchings on \(\mathbb F_2^4\). It does not give a higher-dimensional formula or classify profiles up to linear equivalence. Exhaustiveness rests on two transparent finite recursions that are replayed by the packaged verifier. The dimension-four existence theorem is prior work; the new claim is the complete realization-count spectrum and uniqueness gap. Focused literature searches cannot by themselves prove novelty.
title: Complete prescribed-difference matching multiplicity spectrum in dimension four
